name: summarization
description: Source passages scored with TF-IDF cosine against a reference summary and contains checks for two key points.

cases.input:
id: outage
Summarize the passage.

On Monday the checkout API stopped accepting payments at 10:15 UTC. Engineers rolled back the rate-limiter change and restored service after 42 minutes. Orders placed during the outage were replayed from the queue and no charges were duplicated.
cases.reference: Checkout was down for 42 minutes. The failure was in the checkout API.

cases.input:
id: hiring
Summarize the passage.

The platform group is hiring three engineers, all based in Oslo. Interviews start in May. The roles cover billing, search, and the on-call rotation. Contractors are not eligible.
cases.reference: The platform group is hiring three engineers. The roles are based in Oslo.

cases.input:
id: budget
Summarize the passage.

Finance cut the travel budget by 12 percent for the second half of the year. A travel freeze covers conferences that are not customer meetings. Team offsites already booked are still funded.
cases.reference: Travel spend is cut by 12 percent. A travel freeze covers non-customer conferences.

cases.input:
id: launch
Summarize the passage.

Dark mode ships on Tuesday for every workspace on the Pro plan. The toggle lives in account settings. Free workspaces keep the light theme until the following release.
cases.reference: Dark mode ships on Tuesday. It is available to Pro workspaces.

cases.input:
id: security_patch
Summarize the passage.

Build 4.8.2 patches CVE-2026-1180 in the session signer. Administrators must complete token rotation within 24 hours of upgrading. Old refresh tokens stop working after that window.
cases.reference: Build 4.8.2 patches CVE-2026-1180. Administrators must finish token rotation.

cases.input:
id: warehouse
Summarize the passage.

The Reno warehouse now covers the western states. Standard parcels from Reno arrive in two days. The older Phoenix site still handles returns.
cases.reference: The Reno warehouse serves the western states. Standard parcels arrive in two days.

cases.input:
id: training
Summarize the passage.

Every employee completes the phishing refresher by 30 June. The module takes twenty minutes and includes a simulated invoice lure. Managers see who has not finished.
cases.reference: Staff complete the phishing refresher by 30 June. The module includes a simulated lure.

cases.input:
id: pricing
Summarize the passage.

The annual plan is 18 percent cheaper than paying month to month. The discount appears on the first invoice. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal.
cases.reference: The annual plan costs 18 percent less than monthly billing. The discount is on the first invoice.

cases.input:
id: migration
Summarize the passage.

The primary database moves to Postgres 16 on Saturday. A read-only window lasts about twenty minutes while replicas catch up. Writes submitted during that window are rejected with a retry hint.
cases.reference: The database moves to Postgres 16. A read-only window lasts about twenty minutes.

cases.input:
id: support_queue
Summarize the passage.

Priority tickets are now answered in under four hours during the weekday. They sit in a priority queue ahead of general questions. The target does not apply on regional holidays.
cases.reference: Priority tickets are answered in under four hours. They use a priority queue.
